request: Rename the `watched` field of watchlist items to `seen` everywhere.

requests.title: Watchlist > navigates via the title link without toggling watched
requests.reason: The assertion reads the watchlist item's watched state via `store.items()[0].watched`, but the `WatchItem` field was renamed from `watched` to `seen`. Keeping `.watched` would fail TypeScript compilation and read `undefined` at runtime. Updated the field reference to `.seen`; the test's intent (clicking the title link navigates without changing the watched state) is unchanged.

approvals.title: Watchlist > navigates via the title link without toggling watched
